source_admission: Primary agency records and author-produced technical texts, read at the stated scopes. Physical calculations, proposed activities and conditional commercial demand are distinct. No external papers or datasets are redistributed.

sources.title: Bukley, Paloski and Clement: Physics of Artificial Gravity
sources.reading_scope: Introduction and sections 2.1-2.3 on centrifugal acceleration, radial gradient and directional Coriolis effects read from primary PDF text. No whole-chapter or human-comfort validation; malformed text extraction of the rpm conversion is not used.
sources.use: Rotating comparisons use a=omega^2 R and the vector Coriolis relation. Venue tolerances, geometry and all numerical comparisons are this study's illustrative assumptions.

sources.title: NASA Johnson Space Center: EVA Systems, Active Response Gravity Offload System
sources.reading_scope: ARGOS description, payload offload mechanism and operational-volume passages read. No performance validation or assumed limit on future simulator scale.
sources.use: Earth already offers partial weight offload for people and machinery; supporting one payload does not change gravity throughout its fluids, unrestrained props and surrounding ecosystem.

sources.title: NASA: Parabolic Flight
sources.reading_scope: Description of the reduced-gravity phase and partial-gravity trajectory read; no aircraft technical manual or exact lunar-parabola duration adopted.
sources.use: Whole experiment volumes can experience reduced gravity on Earth for short intervals; sustained site-scale operation is a different service.

sources.title: NASA: Dragonfly Spacecraft and Instruments
sources.reading_scope: Flying on Saturn's Moon passage read. No mission timetable, detailed vehicle performance or transfer of Titan's calm weather to the Open Moon.
sources.use: Dense air plus low gravity benefits flight elsewhere too; lunar advantages concern the combined breathable, warm, inhabited environment and location.

sources.title: Rosales: MIT 18.376 Problem Set 2 answers, Spring 2023
sources.reading_scope: Section 3 governing assumptions and dispersion-relation derivation, Equation 3.9, read from primary teaching text. No wave-making hardware or breaking-wave validation.
sources.use: Linear inviscid gravity-wave relation omega^2=g k tanh(k h), used for same-geometry timing comparisons.

sources.title: Georgi: The Physics of Waves, Chapter 11, MIT OCW edition
sources.reading_scope: Equations 11.137-11.140 and gravity/surface-tension crossover explanation read from primary teaching text. No complete textbook review.
sources.use: Capillary crossover length scales as sqrt(surface tension/(density*g)); a larger crossover does not imply arbitrarily large free liquid shapes.

sources.title: Rostampour et al.: Evaluating the environmental factors on microplastic generation: an accelerated weathering study
sources.reading_scope: NIST primary publication record and abstract, published 2025-03-05, read. Full paper, experimental spectral distribution and data unexamined.
sources.use: PET weathering depends on UV, temperature and humidity together. No lifespan multiplier or transfer of an erythemal UV index to industrial polymers.

sources.title: NASA: New Evidence Adds to Findings Hinting at Network of Caves on Moon
sources.reading_scope: Agency account of the Mini-RF analysis read, including the inferred extension exceeding 200 feet and unknown full extent. Carrer et al. Nature Astronomy direct retrieval failed; no full paper or cave-stability assessment claimed.
sources.use: Authentic geological field sites support distinctive activities, but a radar-inferred conduit does not validate city-size stable caverns.

sources.title: Jones: The Partial Gravity of the Moon and Mars Appears Insufficient to Maintain Human Health, ICES-2021-142
sources.reading_scope: Abstract and introduction read. The paper synthesizes indirect evidence; no clinical validation or current exhaustive medical review.
sources.use: Lower mechanical support loads do not establish therapeutic benefit or long-term health. Its suggested gravity threshold is not adopted as a measured human limit.

local_context.use: Vehicle concepts, flight mechanics and wind/traffic qualifications; old fleet design screens are not new 301 K vehicle qualification.
Ballistic motion, traction, inertia and unresolved long-term human performance.
Hybrid-region area, resident welfare, six travel directions and accounting against double counting.
Possible agricultural/economic roles and host/habitation capacity; engineered living hosts are conditional.
Selected UV filtering, retained UVA and distinction between biological action spectra and general material damage.
Living light as conditional biological design; natural contemporary light levels do not establish path illumination.
Long day/night and regional experience; inherited climate details are not requalified for 301 K.
Qualified product-cycle comparison is needed before claiming industrial advantage.
Suspension benefits and recovery costs; no general gravity premium.
Material-specific oxygen/diluent opportunity and limits on fire-loss claims.
Existing gross/net product reference kept unchanged.
Managed fresh seas, freshwater shores and slower drainage/settling; no new assumption of water clarity or nutrient sufficiency.
